hero.title: Better Gattaran
hero.subtitle: A community-driven portal for civic information about the Municipality of Gattaran in Cagayan. Content is independently maintained and should be verified with the appropriate government office before use.

services.title: Services & Information
services.description: Browse general municipal service categories. Requirements, fees, schedules, contacts, and procedures will be published only after verification.

governmentActivity.title: Government Activity
governmentActivity.description: Browse the portal's municipal information structure. Verified activities, announcements, and public records can be added as sources become available.

footer.status: Better Gattaran is a community-driven civic information portal and is not presented as the official Municipality of Gattaran website.
footer.attribution: Built from the open-source BetterLocalGov project by BetterGov.
